chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Cab's bandsmen: Tyree Glenn, Chu Berry, Lamar Wright and Jerry Blake
summary: Danny lists the men in Cab's band, including clarinetist Jerry Blake, who used the name Jacinto Chabania and crossed the color line.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Do you remember some of the guys in his band? You know, Tyree...

Tyree, Chu Berry, Greeley Walton, Walter Thomas, Lamar Wright... Lamar's got two sons who played trumpet; they must have had the children playing trumpets. And there was Jerry Blake, a fantastic musician, swings,
played a whole lot of clarinet...
He changed his name to Jacinto Chabania or something like that...

I think that was his original name. Jacinto Chabania. That was his original name, I think. He was part Spanish and part Black, and he used to jump the fence all the time. His wife, I think she was jumping the fence, too. I don't think she was Black.
Yeah, he'd come from out of Michigan somewhere.
You know, he was all right until he went on a drinking spree. He'd eat bananas and drink. You remember that? Do you remember seeing him do that?
[LAUGHING] I guess so! But what a musician he was.
And he was highly respected, he was handsome, he had everything going. And he didn't bother nobody...
Not until he got on that booze.
Well, I never saw him like that.
Ooh, he could go... He'd go off the deep... You couldn't find him. Do you remember how ...(?)...., he was always running looking for the chef on the train late at night, so he could get a free meal?
